name: unikit-architecture
description: Generate, update or reorganize the architecture guidelines of a game project. Scans the project structure and tech stack, then writes .unikit/ARCHITECTURE.md — a root with the module map and the global dependency rules — and, when the file grows, topic files in .unikit/architecture/ that agents load only when the work matches them. Modes: generate (no file yet), update (rescan and add what is missing, removing nothing), optimise (split a large file into a root and topics), chosen by a keyword or from the request in plain words. Name a specific pattern or let it auto-detect. Use when the user wants to define, document, update or slim down the project architecture, e.g. "generate architecture", "update the architecture document", "the architecture file is too big", "split ARCHITECTURE.md", or mentions module structure, module boundaries, project organization, or dependency rules.
